title: Refactor SYNC-4917 Migrate to use app-services FxA state machine

target.summary: Calling accountManager.getCurrentDeviceId() synchronously on the main thread during scheduled sync blocks on the Rust FxA client's internal mutex, freezing the UI whenever another thread is performing an account operation.
notes: synchronous call to getCurrentDeviceId() on the main thread
definition of getCurrentDeviceId(), which performs a blocking FFI call synchronously instead of dispatching off the caller's thread
